(2) The scene cuts to a close-up of the closed product box labeled 'pino'. In the background, other strawberry-flavored snack bags, including a red bag of Caramel Corn, are placed on the table under bright, even indoor lighting. (3) A hand uses a small blue plastic pick to spear one of the pink chocolates. The chocolate has a slightly bumpy, textured coating. The camera remains static and focuses on the hand and the box. (4) The hand holds the picked chocolate closer to the camera, revealing a bite taken out of it. The interior is a smooth, light pink ice cream. The background is slightly blurred, maintaining focus on the food item. (5) The hand holds the pino box in front of a glass-door supermarket freezer. The freezer is stocked with various brands of ice cream and snacks, lit by bright cool-toned artificial lights. It displays a URL and social media icons for Facebook, Instagram, and LINE with hand-drawn style arrows and icons.
